name: Richard Legaspi
office: City of Norwalk, Member of the City Council

items.text: A city commissioner since 1991, Richard LeGaspi chairs Norwalk's Public Safety Commission and sits on the Social Service Commission. Elected to the Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District Board in 1999 and 2003, he served as vice president and president. He is a past president of the Norwalk Chamber of Commerce and vice president of the SELACO Workforce Development Board.

sentences.text: A city commissioner since 1991, Richard LeGaspi chairs Norwalk's Public Safety Commission and sits on the Social Service Commission.
Elected to the Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District Board in 1999 and 2003, he served as vice president and president.
He is a past president of the Norwalk Chamber of Commerce and vice president of the SELACO Workforce Development Board.

items.text: His campaign emphasizes gang vigilance, afterschool programs, and investment in youth. He told the Press-Telegram that public safety is the city's top concern. His campaign supports senior housing, affordable units in new developments, and down-payment assistance. He proposes a small-business incubator, a buy-local program, and career pathways. He advocates seeking grants and partnerships before spending city dollars.
